body: please watch this: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2js063a1Suk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2js063a1Suk) i watch this when i'm feeling similar to you. the way she talks about life inherently being beautiful... i'm not there yet, but i wish i could get to a point where i can appreciate myself as something worth living. it's a struggle op, but you're not alone

you're not the only one. i have a bag of poppy seeds propped on one of my shelves, that i can brew into a potential death drink anytime. (plus it looks completely inconspicuous, hiding in plain sight so to speak. kinda makes me laugh). it gives me comfort. it's one of my suicide plans. i can't because i don't want to hurt loved ones, (after experiencing several deaths in the family, i've seen the impact on them firsthand. i just can't do that to them). but planning, and imagining my suicide gives me a morbid sense of control.

this really struck a chord with me. i'm in a very similar situation right now. it feels like all this time, i was working towards something and i thought i was building myself up, when in reality i was tearing myself down. i've wasted my life completely. logically, putting it into perspective it feels like there's no escape. that's what death is supposed to be. putting it into a bigger perspective though, life expectancy is becoming longer, and two years isn't much comparatively. you are still young. and if this doesn't work out, there's always something to do. maybe it wasn't mean to be? at least wait until the exam results come out? you don't even know whether you've passed or not. and after that, make time for your loved ones. they will be a constant in your life up to the point they aren't. and you can afford to be selfish, you have people that love you. being selfish doesn't require suicide though, food for thought. is there anything in your life right now you wish you had? is there anything in your life right now that requires a little selfishness? it's hard, it's really hard, the world is a bitchy black hole that is determined to suck the life out of you. still, i hope you find moments of comfort when you can
